name: JiaoZuo WanFang Aluminum Manufacturing Co., Ltd
summary: JiaoZuo WanFang Aluminum Manufacturing Co., Ltd engages in the smelting and processing of aluminum products in China. The company offers electrolytic aluminum liquid, aluminum ingots, molten aluminum, aluminum alloy products, and electricity. It is also involved in the sale of aluminum products and metal materials; hedging business; thermal power generation; commodity trading; waste disposal; heating; and water and gas supply activities. The company's products are used in the housing construction, transportation, packaging, power electronics, new energy vehicles, photovoltaic power generation, and consumer electronic industries.
